provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: shift=2004 (L17) offsets Grid B by 2004 m while the nesting boundary line is drawn at 2000 (L26, L38) -- the 4 m difference (one coarse cell) is unexplained in the file.
audit_member_text: The Grid B data origin is shifted to 2004 on line 17 while the annotated nesting boundary is drawn at x=2000 on lines 26 and 38; the four-unit gap may represent grid staggering, but no comment states the intended interface convention.

base_member_text: Snapshot names eta_0100..0400 with time labels 100-400 s imply 1-s snapshot numbering; dx1/dx2 in meters and the 1D profile assumption (z loaded as vector) depend on the run configuration, external to this file.
fdir1/fdir2 are hard-coded personal paths; unterminated statements at L8 and L10/L44/L55/L65 echo to console.

audit_member_text: Cross-snapshot range defect: x1 and x2 are computed once from the lengths of snapshot 0100 on lines 14-15, but z1 and z2 are replaced by snapshots 0200/0300/0400 on lines 45-46, 56-57, and 66-67 without recomputing coordinates. Any later snapshot length change causes plot dimension errors or assigns coordinates from the wrong grid extent.
Portability defect: both input directories are hard-coded absolute paths under one user's home directory on lines 2-3, with no existence or load-error checks.
The annotations label the four suffixes as t=100s through t=400s on lines 39-42, but the code does not read time metadata or establish that file suffixes are seconds.

The code assumes each loaded eta file is a vector compatible with length-based row coordinate construction; matrix-shaped files can make plot orientation/length semantics differ, and no shape validation is performed.
